item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las pad+ma'i rnam thar mtshan brgyad bka' yi thang yig dri med pad+ma'i phreng ba
item.coloph: zhes kho bo hu chen gling pas shar rdza'i khrod du ma 'gags brda yig las shar bzhin legs par grub pa bgyis pas thog ma'i drung yig pa rgyal tshab blo gros rgya mtshos byas pa'o//
